name: TC-421: public create happy path returns a manage link; the manage view is public-safe
description: POST .../reservations (public, no auth) → 201, confirmationCode + manageUrl carrying the manage token. GET the manage view with that token → 200, a public-safe projection (status/scheduledAt/partySize/guestName/restaurantName/cancellable/confirmationCode) with NO internalNotes field at all.
